question: According to the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5), what percentage of children under five years are underweight?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**0.321**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5)**, **32.1%** of children under the age of five years are categorized as **underweight** in India.
 
• The term **underweight** refers to a condition where a child's weight is significantly below the norm for their age, indicating potential issues such as **malnutrition** or inadequate dietary intake.
 
• **NFHS-5** is the fifth round of the **National Family Health Survey**, conducted under the supervision of the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** of the Government of India.
 
• The survey provides valuable insights into various health and demographic indicators, such as **nutrition, maternal and child health, family planning, immunization, and sanitation**.
 
• The data for **NFHS-5** was collected during 2019–2021, and it covered **707 districts** across all states and union territories in India.
 
• The findings of NFHS-5 help policymakers and stakeholders to address issues such as **child malnutrition** and implement targeted programs to improve **nutrition and health standards**.
 
• The percentage of underweight children has shown a slight decline over the years, highlighting the impact of initiatives like the **Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)** and **Poshan Abhiyan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
